evals.prompt: I recorded a quick talking-head clip for YouTube (talk.mp4). Cut out the ums, the sentence I restarted and the dead air, then give me a vertical 9:16 Short version with bold viral captions where the important word turns yellow. The word-level transcript is already in words.json (Whisper can't download models on this machine).
evals.expected_output: A rough cut without fillers/retake/dead air, a 1080x1920 version, burned-in viral captions inside the safe zone with meaning-chosen key words, QA run and frames inspected, honest report.

evals.prompt: here's a video from a creator whose editing i love (creator_ref.mp4). break down their editing style so i can copy it on my own videos: pacing, cuts, captions, colors, everything. give me a style card i can reuse
evals.expected_output: Measured style card (cuts/min, shot lengths, cut types, caption font/case/size/position/highlight, palette hex, loudness) with reasons, flags single-video limitation, asks for confirmation.

evals.prompt: Make me an animated stat card for my YouTube video: 'We grew from 1,200 to 48,000 subscribers in 9 months'. Clean premium look, 16:9, about 5 seconds, transparent background so I can drop it over my talking head footage. Actually render it. (GSAP CDN is blocked here; a local gsap.min.js is in inputs/.)
evals.expected_output: A rendered transparent MOV/WebM 1920x1080 ~5s, counter with tabular numbers, one accent, deterministic HyperFrames composition, frames inspected, lint clean.
